pkgmetadata.longdescription: GSD Core (Git. Ship. Done.) is a meta-prompting, context-engineering and spec-driven development system for AI coding agents. This package builds the same upstream tarball as dev-util/gsd-core but applies FILESDIR patches that make the Kimi Code (Moonshot's Node CLI) deployment actually work: correct hook event/matcher wiring for ~/.kimi-code/config.toml, hook-payload normalization gated on Kimi Code's client_type stamp, block reasons mirrored to stderr, skill/agent path conversion for $HOME/.kimi-code, and a statusline that understands Kimi Code's camelCase snapshot. It installs side-by-side with the vanilla package, exposing only the gsd-core-kimi-code deployer.
